notes.title: Final Fantasy Type-0 HD Game Camera Update (30th September 2015)
notes.notes:
We’ve got a new update for Final Fantasy Type-0 HD today (30th September 2015) that fixes a previous issue with the camera. Once you update the game, the camera turning speed setting now works properly, which is good news!

Hope you guys are still enjoying Final Fantasy Type-0 HD and thanks again for playing!

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD Game update (18th September)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we’re very excited to announce the following updates.

Improvements:
[list][*]Improved mouse controls
[*]Display dynamically adjusts to controller/keyboard configuration
[*]Additional resolutions supported during full screen play:[/list]
  1920 x 1200
  1680 x 1050
  1600 x 1200
  1600 x 1024
  1600 x 900
  1366 x 768
  1360 x 768
  1280 x 1024
  1280 x 960
  1280 x 800
  1280 x 768


Thanks for playing, we hope you enjoy FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD!

notes.title: FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD Game update (4th September 2015)
notes.notes:
Hi guys, thank you for playing FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD and we hope you are enjoying the game!

We’ve been listening to your comments and have been working hard trying to make your gameplay experience better. We have updated FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD as of today, September 4th, 2015.

Improvements:
[list][*]Reduced the rate of incorrect lip-syncing during movie scenes.
[*]The mouse pointer now disappears during gameplay when a controller is connected.
[*]Additional dumpfile output specification when facing crash issues, to help us identify the cause of issues.[/list]

We hope you enjoy playing FINAL FANTASY TYPE-0 HD and hope to bring you further updates soon.
